name: CenteredCta
title: CenteredCta
summary: Light, centred call to action (eyebrow, headline, two buttons) in a white card, plus a compact inline banner card for one question and one action.
whenToUse: Centred CTA `.dp-ccta`: the end of an inner page that should lead somewhere (Become a partner, Talk to our team, Download the app).
Inline banner `.card.card-flat.dp-banner`: a quiet prompt after content, such as "Still have a question?" on FAQ and Our Team pages.
Use CtaBand for the bold dark closing band on the home page.
whenNotToUse: Do not stack two CTAs back to back; one per page end.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline (h2), about 8 words. Wrap one word in `<span className="em">`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Two buttons: one primary and one `outlineLight` `Button`. Never two blue buttons.

props.name: headingId
props.description: Id of the h2; generated when omitted.

variantNotes: Centred CTA: white, `--gray-200` border, `--radius-lg`, 48px × 32px padding, 20px gap; headline 32px (`.dp-ccta-title`).
Inline banner: `.card-flat` laid out as a row (`.dp-banner`), text left, one button right, 28px padding; wraps to a column on narrow screens.
Static; buttons own their hover and focus states.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One Horizon Blue `.btn-primary` per CTA; the second action is `.btn-secondary`. Never two blue buttons.
The banner has exactly one button.
One `.em` word in the centred headline; none in the banner.
Headlines are short (about 8 words); the banner's supporting line is one short sentence.
Place on `--off-white` page backgrounds so the white card reads as a surface.
↗ only when the button leaves the site.
